content: Filisitibɑ bɑ Isirelibɑ tɑbu wɔri. Mɑ Isirelibɑn tɑbu kowobu bɑ duki suɑ. Filisiti be, bɑ bu nɑɑ ɡirɑ bɑ ɡo ɡo Giliboɑn ɡuurɔ.
Bɑ mɑɑ Sɔɔlun tii kɑ win bibu itɑ Yonɑtɑm kɑ Abinɑdɑbu kɑ Mɑɑkisuɑ nɑɑmwɛ. Mɑ bɑ bii be ɡo.
Sɑnnɔ ɡe, ɡɑ Sɔɔlu swĩɛ. Tɛn towobu bɑ nùn sɛ̃ɛnu twee bɑ mɛɛrɑ kuɑ ɡem ɡem.

Yerɑ u win tɑbu yɑ̃ɑ sɔɔwo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, u win tɑkobi womɔ u nùn ye sɔku kpɑ bɑnɡo sɑriruɡii be, bu ku rɑɑ nùn sɔku bu yɑɑ kɑsiki. Adɑmɑ durɔ wi, u yinɑ u ko mɛ, domi bɛrum nùn mwɑ ɡem ɡem. Mɑ Sɔɔlu u tɑkobi ye mwɑ u kɑ tii sɔkɑ u kibɑrisi u tɑɑre.
Ye win tɑbu yɑ̃ɑ sɔɔwo wi, u wɑ mɑ u ɡu, yerɑ u mɑɑ win tɑkobi suɑ u tii sɔkɑ nɡe mɛ Sɔɔlu u kuɑ. Mɑ bɑ ɡu yɑm tem mi.
Nɡe mɛyɑ Sɔɔlu u kɑ ɡu kɑ win bibu itɑ be, kɑ win tɑbu yɑ̃ɑ sɔɔwo kɑ sere mɑɑ win tɑbu kowobu kpuro sɑnnu.
Ye Isireli be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yisirɛɛlin wɔwɑɔ bɑ nuɑ mɑ ben tɑbu kowobɑ duki suɑ, Sɔɔlu kɑ win bii tɔn durɔbu bɑ mɑɑ ɡu, yerɑ bɑ ben wusu deri bɑ duki suɑ. Mɑ Filisitibɑ bɑ nɑ bɑ sinɑ wuu si sɔɔ.
Ye n kuɑ sisiru Filisitibɑ bɑ nɑ bɑ ɡoo nin yɑ̃nu potirimɔ. Yerɑ bɑ Sɔɔlu kɑ win bibu itɑn ɡonu wɑ Giliboɑn ɡuurɔ.
Mɑ bɑ Sɔɔlun wiru burɑ bɑ win tɑbu yɑ̃nu kpuro potirɑ. Yerɑ bɑ sɔmɔbu ɡɔrɑ bu yen lɑbɑɑri kpɑrɑ ben bũu diɑɔ kɑ ben tɔmbun mi, ben tem sɔɔ kpuro.
Yerɑ bɑ win tɑbu yɑ̃nu suɑ bɑ doke ben bũu dirɔ. Mɑ bɑ win wiru suɑ bɑ bwɛ̃ ben bũu wi bɑ mɔ̀ Dɑɡonin dirɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yɑbɛsi ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Gɑlɑdin temɔ, yen tɔmbu bɑ nuɑ ye Filisitibɑ bɑ Sɔɔlu kuɑ,
yerɑ be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɑbu durɔ wɔruɡɔbɑ bɑ seewɑ bɑ Sɔɔlu kɑ win bibun ɡoo ni suɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ Yɑbɛsiɔ. Mɑ bɑ ben kukunu sikuɑ dɑ̃ru ɡɑrun nuurɔ Yɑbɛsi mi. Mɑ bɑ nɔɔ bɔkuɑ sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru.
Sɔɔlu u ɡuwɑ yèn sɔ̃ u Yinni Gusunɔ tɔnu kɑm kom kuɑ, u ǹ win woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɛ. U bikiɑru dɑwɑ be bɑ rɑ ɡɔribu sokun mi.
U ǹ Yinni Gusunɔ bikie. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ u ɡu. Mɑ u win bɑndu suɑ u Isɑin bii, Dɑfidi wɛ̃.
